lines.text: Go home or go to home?
Many learners say: I go to home after work.
Better: I go home after work.

data.wrong: I go to home after work.

native.tip: Перед home не нужен “to”: “I go home after work.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I go to home after work”? 😅 По аналогии с “go to school” хочется добавить “to.” Но перед home он не нужен. Правильно: “I go home after work.” Послушай Аму и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “home.” Go home — без to. Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.hook: Go home or go to home?
en.tip: No “to” before home: “I go home after work.”
en.caption: Do you also say “I go to home after work”? 😅 After “go to school,” it is easy to add “to,” but home needs no “to.” Correct: “I go home after work.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
